title: ABCs vs. The Distraction
hook: The NCLEX gives you 5 urgent tasks. 95% pick the wrong one first.
scenario: Post-op patient: BP 88/52, RR 28, wound dressing saturated, family demanding pain medication, IV line infiltrated. What do you address FIRST?
answer: Airway and Breathing first — RR 28 indicates respiratory distress. Circulation next (BP 88/52). Pain and family are important but NOT priority over ABCs.
payoff: The ABC Rule: Airway → Breathing → Circulation. Everything else comes after. The NCLEX will ALWAYS test if you know this order.
caption:
🚨 NCLEX Trap of the Day: ABCs vs. Distraction

Post-op patient:
• BP 88/52
• RR 28
• Saturated dressing
• Family wants pain meds
• IV infiltrated

What's FIRST?

A) Change wound dressing
B) Call provider for pain med
C) Restart IV
D) Assess airway & breathing

Answer: D

ABCs ALWAYS come first. RR 28 = respiratory distress.
